title: Garlic Lime Prawn Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
summary: Bright Mexican-style tacos filled with juicy garlic-lime prawns, crunchy cabbage slaw and a creamy yoghurt-lime drizzle. They make a fresh, quick pescatarian lunch with plenty of zing and texture.
steps: Make the slaw by tossing the shredded red cabbage, grated carrot, spring onions, half the coriander, 2 tablespoons lime juice, 1 tablespoon olive oil and 0.25 teaspoon salt in a bowl. Scrunch lightly with your hands for 30 seconds, then set aside while you cook the prawns.
Stir the plain yogurt with 1 tablespoon lime juice, a pinch of salt and a little black pepper to make a quick lime crema. Loosen with a teaspoon of water if you want it more drizzleable.
Pat the prawns dry. Toss them with the minced garlic, cumin, paprika, chilli powder, remaining 1 tablespoon lime juice, remaining 0.5 teaspoon salt and black pepper.

Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the prawns in a single layer and cook for 2 minutes, then turn and cook for 1–2 minutes more until pink, opaque and lightly golden at the edges.
Warm the corn tortillas in a dry frying pan for about 30 seconds per side until flexible and lightly toasted, or wrap and microwave briefly until soft.
Fill each tortilla with cabbage slaw and garlic-lime prawns. Drizzle with the lime yogurt, scatter over the remaining coriander and serve with lime wedges for squeezing.
